html:
Unique Research · Partner · September 27, 2024

Unique Research welcomes TiMotion AI (钛镁AI) as a Unique Partner — an enterprise AIGC marketing-agent platform built for marketers.

Turning real-person photos into animation and AI copy are no longer novel alone; combining both in live cross-industry campaigns is still rare. At the 10th GDMS Global Digital Marketing Summit, TiMotion’s custom AI posters drew attention: upload a photo, pick a style, enter a marketing/event prompt → personalized poster with slogan. Guests forwarded aggressively — efficiency plus interactivity vs classic promo kits.

How AI remakes marketing — TiMotion’s path

“AI remakes marketing” is often said; in practice AI is already rewriting chain and execution detail. TiMotion shipped an enterprise AIGC marketing-agent platform — AI writing, painting, posters, plus new AI video and AI marketing search — more human/ops-friendly and marketing-focused. Serving many customers, it iterates industry knowledge from “pro” toward “expert.” Marketers want enterprise AI that slots into the whole workflow:

  • Research: enter product/brand → personas, market state, competitiveness, reference reports.
  • Creative: keywords → copy, posters, even video scripts.
  • Audience interaction: sentiment watch, narrative guidance, brand promo, community, virtual CS — personalized, human-like after training.

Slogan: “TiMotion AI — the agent that understands marketing.” Coverage spans content creation, data analysis, and reputation management. Multi-dimensional marketing corpora trained on auto, insurance, apparel, and more.

UI: after login — AI marketing search, Agents, and Digital Employees; Agents include AI write / paint / poster / video; upgraded minimal UI.

Dual engines: AI video + AI marketing search

1. AI video — efficient marketing short-form
Aimed at e-commerce ad shorts with host narration / VO. On competitive short-video platforms, AI cuts cost and raises volume vs script→pro shoot→fine edit (worse for apparel/FMCG SKU sprawl). Flow: paste product detail-page URL → AI grabs assets, sets audience, writes scripts trained on strong ad-script data → pick template + brand digital twin → synthesize in minutes (days → minutes). Digital hosts with natural lip/motion for trust. Users can manually tweak assets/copy/templates before one-click assemble — human override while models remain uncertain. Live in auto, finance, FMCG, apparel — batch content, attention, and conversion lift.

2. AI marketing search — tool for marketers
While Baidu, Quark, Zhihu, Douyin race general AI search, TiMotion’s marketing search is tuned for marketers: sentiment, high-frequency keywords, user concerns, competitive analysis, market size/growth, structure and rivalry. Traits: (1) marketing-relevant only; (2) multi-dimension decision data; (3) cross-industry + industry-custom training; (4) marketing Q&A personalization.

Industry depth & five core capabilities

Enhanced training on industry + private enterprise data — public marketing materials, social comments, multi-domain CS dialogues, ad copy — plus custom / dedicated-model consult and fast landing as brand marketing advisor.

Five capabilities visible in product: strong content generation; rigorous planning; flexible task orchestration; complex decision-making; macro analysis/judgment.

Close

As a full-chain GenAI marketing platform — creation, analytics, reputation — TiMotion lowers the on-ramp for marketers to use AI. AI marketing is widely seen as a key future vector; this partnership welcomes a specialist agent stack into the Unique ecosystem.

— END —
